title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jared Bartlett waived by Jaguars
items.desc: The Jaguars waived linebacker Jared Bartlett with an injury designation.
items.impact: Bartlett will figure to seek another opportunity when he is cleared.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jahlani Tavai signs with Jaguars
items.desc: The Jaguars signed LB Jahlani Tavai.
items.impact: Tavai was released by the Patriots in March. He totaled 42 tackles and a forced fumble in 12 games with seven starts last season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jeadyn Lukus signs with Browns
items.desc: The Browns signed CB Jeadyn Lukus.
items.impact: Lukus will compete for a depth role in the secondary for Cleveland.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jack Conley re-signs with Browns
items.desc: The Browns re-signed OL Jack Conley.
items.impact: Conley will add depth on the offensive line for Cleveland.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kendrick Green placed on IR
items.desc: The Browns placed OL Kendrick Green on injured reserve.
items.impact: Green will likely be sidelined for the upcoming season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Reid Carrico waived by Browns
items.desc: The Browns waived LB Reid Carrico.
items.impact: Carrico will figure to seek another opportunity during training camp.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jamari Thrash waived by Browns
items.desc: The Browns waived WR Jamari Thrash with injury designation.
items.impact: Thrash will seek another opportunity when he is cleared.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: De'Shawn Rucker waived by Lions
items.desc: The Lions have waived injured CB De'Shawn Rucker.
items.impact: Rucker will seek another opportunity when he is cleared.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ben Stille signs with Lions
items.desc: The Lions signed DE Ben Stille.
items.impact: Stille ended last season on the Falcons' practice squad. He will compete for a depth role on the Lions defensive line.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Joseph Vaughn waived by Seahawks
items.desc: The Seahawks waived LB Joseph Vaughn.
items.impact: Vaugn will figure to seek another opportunity. Power Echols was signed as the corresponding move.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Power Echols signs with Seahawks
items.desc: The Seahawks signed LB Power Echols.
items.impact: Echols spent time with the Bears and Texans last season. He did not appear in a regular season game.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Daniel Rickert signs with Rams
items.desc: The Rams signed DE Daniel Rickert.
items.impact: Rickert will compete for a depth role on the Rams defensive line.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: A.T. Perry waived by Steelers
items.desc: The Steelers waived WR A.T. Perry.
items.impact: Perry will figure to seek another opportunity. The Steelers claimed WR Colton Dowell off waivers as the corresponding move.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: JJ Galbreath waived by Steelers
items.desc: The Steelers waived TE JJ Galbreath.
items.impact: Galbreath will figure to seek another opportunity during training camp. They claimed TE Lance Mason as the corresponding move.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: William Bradley-King reaches injury settlement with 49ers
items.desc: The 49ers reached an injury settlement to part ways with DE William Bradley-King.
items.impact: Bradley-King had cleared waivers and reverted to the 49ers injured reserve.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Colton Dowell claimed off waivers by Steelers
items.desc: The Steelers claimed WR Colton Dowell off waivers.
items.impact: Dowell was waived by the 49ers. He will compete for a depth role in the Steelers wide receiver room.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Lance Mason claimed off waivers by Steelers
items.desc: The Steelers claimed TE Lance Mason off waivers.
items.impact: Mason was waived by the Seahawks. He will compete for a depth role in the Steelers right end room.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Brenden Jaimes signs with Giants
items.desc: The Giants signed C Brenden Jaimes.
items.impact: Jaimes will provide depth for the Giants with John Michael Schmitz likely headed to the concussion protocol.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jarrick Bernard-Converse waived by Giants
items.desc: The Giants waived CB Jarrick Bernard-Converse with an injury designation.
items.impact: Bernard-Converse had been dealing with a knee injury and hadn't practice in several days. He'll figure to seek another opportunity when he is cleared.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Omar Brown waived by Dolphins
items.desc: The Dolphins waived/injured safety Omar Brown.
items.impact: Brown will figure to seek another opportunity during training camp when he is cleared.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Mark Gronowski waived by Dolphins
items.desc: The Dolphins waived QB Mark Gronowski.
items.impact: Gronkowski will figure to seek another opportunity during training camp.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ahmari Harvey claimed off waivers by Dolphins
items.desc: The Dolphins claimed CB Ahmari Harvey off waivers.
items.impact: Harvey was waived by the Steelers. He will compete for a depth role in the Dolphins corner back room.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tanner Wall signs with Dolphins
items.desc: The Dolphins signed S Tanner Wall.
items.impact: Wall will compete in training camp for a depth role in the Dolphins secondary.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Zach Harrison activated from NFI list
items.desc: The Falcons activated Zach Harrison from the non-football injury list.
items.impact: Harrison has been cleared to practice after missing the start of training camp.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Deion Jones signs with Saints
items.desc: The Saints signed LB Deion Jones.
items.impact: Jones will compete for a depth role in the Saints linebacker room.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Dominic Richardson waived by Cowboys
items.desc: The Cowboys waived Dominic Richardson.
items.impact: Richardson will seek another opportunity during training camp.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jashaun Corbin signs with Cowboys
items.desc: The Cowboys signed RB Jashaun Corbin.
items.impact: Corbin most recently played for Orlando in the UFL. He will compete for a depth role in the Cowboys backfield.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Max Scharping signs with Commanders
items.desc: The Commanders signed OL Max Scharping.
items.impact: Scharping spent time on Washington's practice squad in 2024.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Keeshawn Silver waived by Saints
items.desc: The Saints waived/injured DL Keeshawn Silver.
items.impact: Silver will figure to seek another opportunity when he is cleared.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Bryan Bresee (knee) placed on IR
items.desc: The Saints placed Bryan Bresee on injured reserve.
items.impact: Bresee will miss the upcoming season after tearing his ACL.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Garrett Nelson claimed off waivers by Saints
items.desc: The Saints claimed EDGE Garrett Nelson off waivers from the Seattle Seahawks.
items.impact: Nelson will compete for a depth role on the defensive line for Seattle.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jaden Robinson waived by Broncos
items.desc: The Broncos waived CB Jaden Robinson with an injury designation.
items.impact: Robinson will figure to seek another opportunity once he is cleared.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jermaine Terry II works out for Dolphins
items.desc: The Dolphins hosted TE Jermaine Terry II for a workout.
items.impact: Terry was one of five tight ends to workout for Miami. He signed with the Giants as an undrafted free agent last season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tre' McKitty works out for Dolphins
items.desc: The Dolphins hosted TE Tre' McKitty for a workout on Friday.
items.impact: McKitty spent the spring in the UFL. He was one of five tight ends to workout for Miami.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Brandon Frazier works out for Dolphins
items.desc: The Dolphins hosted TE Brandon Frazier for a workout.
items.impact: Frazier was one of five tight ends to workout for Miami. He will compete for a spot in training camp with the Dolphins.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Zach Davidson works out for Dolphins
items.desc: The Dolphins hosted TE Zach Davidson for a workout on Friday.
items.impact: Davidson was one of five tight ends to workout for Miami. He has appeared in three games in his career.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Baylor Cupp works out for Dolphins
items.desc: The Dolphins hosted TE Baylor Cupp for a workout on Friday.
items.impact: Cupp was one of five tight ends to workout for Miami. He has appeared in one career game in the NFL.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ryan Cooper Jr. works out for Lions
items.desc: The Lions hosted DB Ryan Cooper Jr. for a workout.
items.impact: Cooper spent the spring in the UFL. He'll compete for a spot in training camp with Detroit.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Folorunso Fatukasi works out for Lions
items.desc: The Lions hosted DT Folorunso Fatukasi for a workout.
items.impact: Fatukasi was placed on injured reserve due to a shoulder injury with the Texans last season. He'll compete for a spot in training camp with Detroit.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Anthony Kendall works out for Lions
items.desc: The Lions hosted CB Anthony Kendall for a workout.
items.impact: Kendall spent last season with the Browns. He'll compete for a spot in training camp with Detroit.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cam Skattebo suffers apparent injury during practice Friday
items.desc: Cam Skattebo left practice early on Friday.
items.impact: Skattebo went down after a collision with LB Arvell Reese. He remained on the sideline, but didn't return to practice. The Giants will be cautious with him.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jadarian Price not seen practicing Friday
items.desc: Jadarian Price was not seen practicing on Friday at Seahawks training camp.
items.impact: It is unclear as of now what Price is dealing with. The rookie has recently started to see more reps with the first-team offense in camp. There will be more updates provided on his status when available.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Peter Skoronski agrees to four-year extension with Titans
items.desc: Peter Skoronski has agreed to a four-year, $100 million contract extension with the Tennessee Titans according to Ian Rapoport.
items.impact: Skoronski's extension includes $88 million in guarantees while also making the former first-round pick the highest paid guard in the NFL as a key protector of quarterback Cam Ward and a developing Tennessee offense under new head coach Robert Saleh.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Marvin Mims Jr. leaves practice early Friday
items.desc: Marvin Mims Jr. left Friday's practice early.
items.impact: Mims pulled up as he was running after a deep ball from Bo Nix. He was talking with trainers before leaving practice. There will be an update provided when available.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Trey Smith (hip) not practicing Friday
items.desc: Trey Smith is not practicing on Friday due to a hip injury.
items.impact: Chiefs coach Andy Reid said he's not worried about Smith's availability. He should return to practice this weekend or early next week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Xavier Worthy (shoulder) not practicing Friday
items.desc: Xavier Worthy is still not practicing on Friday.
items.impact: Worthy remains absent from practice due to a shoulder injury. It is unclear how much longer he will be sidelined for.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Patrick Mahomes II (knee) unlikely to play in preseason
items.desc: Chiefs head coach Andy Reid said Patrick Mahomes II is unlikely to play in the preseason.
items.impact: Mahomes continues to make progress early on during training camp. He remains hopeful to be good to go for the start of the season, but his status will need to be monitored.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Matt Henningsen carted off field from practice Friday
items.desc: Broncos Matt Henningsen was carted off the field during practice on Friday.
items.impact: Henningsen will be further evaluated. There should be an update on his status when available. Palmer notes he was "in a lot of pain" as he was carted off.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kenny Gainwell (personal) not practicing Friday, expected back Sunday
items.desc: Kenny Gainwell is not practicing on Friday due to personal reasons.
items.impact: It is an excused absence for Gainwell, who is expected to be back on Sunday. He is competing for a complimentary role alongside Bucky Irving.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Brandin Echols (ankle) not practicing Friday
items.desc: Brandin Echols is not practicing on Friday due to an ankle injury.
items.impact: Echols signed a two-year contract with Pittsburgh back in March.
